title: Be authorised to keep gaming machines
what: Possess gaming machines, and conduct gaming on them in a hotel or club, only as the holder of a venue licence endorsed with gaming machine authorities, or as otherwise authorised under the Act.

sources.title: Gaming Control Act 1993 (Tas)
sources.quote: Despite the provision of any other Act or any law, the conduct of gaming is lawful when the gaming is conducted, and the gaming equipment is provided, by or on behalf of the holder of a venue licence in accordance with this Act at licensed premises in respect of which the venue licence is in force

sources.title: Gaming Control Act 1993 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is not authorised under this Act must not possess gaming equipment

sources.title: Gaming Control Act 1993 (Tas)
